{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check arm and severity association
print('\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(df["arm"], df["severity"]))

# Check for assay_batch B values in biomarker_final
print('\nSample of biomarker_final for assay_batch == B:')
print(df[df["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].head())"}
